purpose: Measure whether Symthaea can retrieve the correct Leptos 0.8 engineering pattern from paraphrased developer intent, while abstaining when the corpus has no relevant answer.

queries.query: I need to split my page into reusable Rust UI pieces that each return part of the view tree.
What is the idiomatic way to declare a page root and compose its markup with the macro?
A text field and a submit button both need access to the same component-local value. How should I own that state?
How do I make a view update when a value changes and still allow event handlers to change it?
Why does reading a signal inside an effect cause reruns, but reading it through the untracked accessor does not?
I want to sample the latest gateway URL on each retry without making the effect subscribe to that signal.
Where should I start a browser subscription or external connection when a component is mounted?
What should an Effect be used for, and what should I avoid using it to synchronize?
A form sends a request asynchronously. How do I handle loading state, success, failure and prevent double submits?
How do I run a browser-side future after a click and ensure the error path also clears the pending indicator?
My messages are appended to a conversation. How should I render the collection and choose stable identity keys?
When is using the array position as a list key safe, and when does it break updates?
I need to draw into a canvas once it exists in the browser DOM. How do I obtain the mounted element?
What is the typed reference pattern for accessing a real HTML canvas from an effect?
The cognitive engine is too large for WebAssembly. How should a small Rust web frontend communicate with it?
Should my browser UI link the full reasoning crate directly, or talk to a narrower service endpoint?
How do I configure nested routes, route parameters and navigation guards in Leptos Router?
What is the correct way to implement server-side rendering and hydrate the page on the client?
How do I style a CSS grid with container queries and fluid typography?
How do I pass typed properties and children through several layers of reusable components?
What is the best way to handle validation and accessible error messages in a multi-step form?
How should I test a Leptos component in a real browser with keyboard navigation and screenshots?
Can I use a CSS animation to make a telemetry visualization move more smoothly?
How can I securely sandbox an agent that can run generated browser code?
How do I declare URL-backed pages and switch between them without manual conditionals?
I need navigation links and the current URL to drive which mode is highlighted in the header.
How can nested page components read one shared application state object without passing it through every prop?
Where should I create a shared state store so route descendants can retrieve it by type?
A category is determined entirely by the selected item. How do I keep it derived instead of storing a second mutable signal?
I have a costly lookup based on one signal and want downstream consumers to observe the computed value.
After the user chooses a track I want to send them back to the Listen page using the router API.
Which hook gives me a programmatic navigation callback inside a route component?
How should I model a complex widget with typed events, state transitions and a list of effects for the browser to perform?
I need state-machine logic I can unit test without rendering a DOM. What architecture fits?
My audio player must keep playing when a user navigates to another route. Where should the audio node live?
How can I keep one browser resource mounted while swapping the page content inside a router?
Browser callbacks may arrive after a new track is loaded. How do I ignore events belonging to an older source?
What is the event-adapter pattern for turning DOM events into typed reducer events with generation IDs?
An import needs a permission choice, and doing nothing must not be treated as consent. How should the UI gate submission?
How do I force an explicit authorisation selection before triggering a mutating request?
When a page mounts, I need to load supporting data and show loading, success and error messages.
How do I start an asynchronous bootstrap fetch in an effect and bind the outcome to reactive state?

controls: Freeze corpus version and query wording before each run.
Do not train or tune retrieval on this public pilot query set and report it as held-out.
Use an additional private query set for final comparison.
Normalize top-k outputs to unique pattern IDs.
Compare under identical corpus, hardware, token budget and latency measurement conditions.
notes: Queries are paraphrases and are not copied from the pattern titles.
Hard negatives deliberately target topics not currently represented by the seventeen-entry corpus.
Expected empty sets require calibrated abstention, not forced retrieval.
No retrieval scores have been measured.
Corpus expanded from eight to seventeen source-grounded patterns; the query set now contains two paraphrases per pattern, plus eight hard negatives.
Every expected pattern ID is drawn from the checked-in 17-pattern corpus; the eight hard negatives intentionally remain outside this initial knowledge coverage.
